title: Natural sort for file names
prompt: Our file browser lists file10 before file2, which users hate. Please implement natural ("human") ordering in natsort.js: naturalCompare(a, b), usable directly as an Array.prototype.sort comparator, and naturalSort(items, options). The exact ordering rules — how numbers, letter case, leading zeros and version-like names are handled, plus the naturalSort options — are in the comment at the top of natsort.js; please follow them exactly, they're what our other clients already do. No dependencies.
